provenance.size_rationale: 48^3 (~110k cells) x ~260 timesteps combining three owned production paths in one run is the largest/most combined workload in this leaf, justifying the acceleration label; smaller isolated checks (laser-3d-wavelength-smoke, window-shift-cadence-grid-advance, injector-flux-density-drift) already establish and justify each sub-observable's tolerance individually.

policy.shape: Three independently recomputed observables on the same run: laser period (zero-crossing, pre-window-start only), window grid-min trajectory (fraction-accumulator recursion restarted at window_start_time), and injected Beam px (near drift_px, temperature=0 at creation).
policy.tolerance_origin: Identical to the three isolated checks that establish each bound: 15% period (laser-3d-wavelength-smoke), 0.5*dx position (window-shift-cadence-grid-advance's own fraction-accumulator recursion), and PX_RTOL from injector-flux-density-drift's self-field formula (space_charge_growing_slab_dp()), evaluated at this deck's own T_END=20fs worst-case residency, giving PX_RTOL~=2.57e-4. Post-repair (v11): the position criterion's delayed-window-start call label (the start_step fed to window_shift_predicted_by_dump_step) is now derived from this deck's nonrestart epoch3d.F90 half-step time stagger (dt/2 before the first output, then dt/2 before/after each subsequent output_routines() call -- lines 123, 159-163, 265-278) instead of round(window_start_time/dt); window.F90's moving_window() (lines 402-430) only observes time=dt/2+n*dt on its n-th call, so the first call visible to a delayed (>0) window_start_time is n=ceil(window_start_time/dt-0.5), 0-based call label L=n-1. round() undercounted this by exactly one call for this deck's non-integer window_start_time/dt~=68.163, producing a one-dx (POSITION_TOL-exceeding) grid-min error; the half-step-derived label matches to floating-point error instead. Post-repair (v8): dt_snapshot was raised from 2fs to 0.2fs -- 2fs exactly equalled ANALYTIC_PERIOD=lambda/c=2fs for this deck's 0.6-micron laser, aliasing the pre-window-start Ey(t) samples to ~1 sample/period (indistinguishable from DC, the root cause of v7's 'found only 0 pre-window-start zero crossings' error); 0.2fs gives ~10 samples/period, matching the ~9 samples/period ratio the sibling laser-3d-wavelength-smoke check uses for its own (different-wavelength) laser. This dt_snapshot change requires a fresh run; no other deck field changed. Post-repair (2026-08-30 real-physics repair pass): the injector_near_momentum bound now also adds a flat, residency-INDEPENDENT laser-quiver term (epoch_physics.laser_quiver_longitudinal_dp(), 5x safety margin like the self-field term) to PX_RTOL. This leaf's own preserved oracle evidence showed the self-field-only bound underestimated a REAL, intended effect unique to this combined deck: once the deck's own laser wavefront (bc_x_min=simple_laser) physically reaches a Beam particle, the particle picks up a genuine relativistic 'figure-8' longitudinal quiver momentum kick (a standard plane-wave-quiver result) -- max_px_rel jumped ~60x between two consecutive dumps at almost exactly the independently-computed wavefront arrival time at the Beam's drifting position, then grew further while particles remained immersed in the pulse, and dropped once the window swept them out. This is the intended substantive content of this row's 'acceleration' label, not a defect to be tolerance-fitted away or weakened into a smoke test.
policy.determinism: temperature=0 injector species (no random momentum spread at creation); single rank; fully deterministic.

criteria.name: window_grid_trajectory
criteria.rule: max |actual - predicted| grid-min <= 0.5*dx after window_start_time, both sides, where the predicted trajectory's delayed-start call label is derived from epoch3d.F90's half-step time stagger (n=ceil(window_start_time/dt-0.5), 0-based label L=n-1), not round(window_start_time/dt)

criteria.name: injector_near_momentum
criteria.rule: checked at EVERY dump that contains a nonempty Px+Beam block (not only the latest survivor -- H1 fix, independent Sol review of PR338), each against its OWN residency-scaled bound max relative |px-drift_px| <= 5*(space_charge_growing_slab_dp(1e20,Q0,eps0,v_inject,t_dump) + laser_quiver_longitudinal_dp(Q0,M0,c,omega,amp))/|drift_px| (self-field term capped at that dump's own recorded time; quiver term is a flat floor, added by the 2026-08-30 real-physics repair pass); a run with zero nonempty Beam Px dumps anywhere fails
